name: RELX PLC
blurb: RELX PLC is a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. The company operates through four segments: Scientific, Technical & Medical; Risk & Business Analytics; Legal; and Exhibitions. It serves customers in over 180 countries and holds leading positions in each of its markets.
recent: In the past 30 days, RELX shares have traded steadily with modest gains, supported by consistent revenue growth and a strong dividend yield. The company reported solid full-year results in February 2025, with underlying revenue growth of 6% and improved margins. No major news or analyst rating changes have emerged in the last month.
